questionEn: What characteristic refers to the concept of “pure substance”?
choicesEn: A substance that is homogeneous in composition and properties throughout its entire volume
choicesUz: Tarkibi va xossalari boʻyicha butun hajmi boʻyicha bir hil boʻlgan modda
explanationEn: A pure substance is homogeneous in composition and properties.
explanationUz: Sof modda tarkibi va xossalari jihatidan bir hildir.
